maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is satellite broadband subscriptions, in-flight connectivity, and government/defense systems, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Larger parts are consumer home internet and commercial aviation/maritime connectivity; government and defense is a smaller segment.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through satellite network and subscriber growth; Inmarsat was one large deal, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Airline, maritime, and military customers depend on embedded terminals and networks; switching means re-equipping, certification and downtime.

notes: Segment mix is from general knowledge; the website text does not give revenue split.
